within the limitations of velixir, 
please implement a feature that allows any visitor to type something within reason like maybe about 500 characters or something 
and then any visitor to the website will instantly see this text as well 
there is no persistence and no guarantee of up time 
so we should probably get rid of any older messages as newer messages come in 
overall the website should be resilient and roll with the punches 
there is no need to support anything but the latest evergreen browser versions 
so please keep the html and css as clean as possible with this in mind 
also somewhere either the header or the footer it should show the current server time and it should keep ticking once a second 
it is critical for the website to be fully responsive 
yes, only evergreen browsers but should work fine on android, iPhone, as well as the desktop / laptop browsers
